description:
On his way to school as a senior, Parang feels nothing in particular. But into his colorless, monotonous daily life comes an unexpected variable: his first love.

*“Sir! Later on… please marry me!”*

However, his confessions, which continue for a whole year, fail every single time. On the snowy day of graduation, one word from Juhwan leads Parang to postpone university and decide to enlist in the military. As time passes, Parang, who thought he would never see Juhwan again, ends up reuniting with him by fate in an unexpected place.

*“Sir, I don’t have anywhere to stay. Could you let me stay just for one night…?”  
“Okay. You can stay.”*

Thus begins their sudden cohabitation-

Will Parang finally be able to achieve the first love he has longed for?
